journey.name: Sport days
journey.description: A class trained away from the app goes on the plan, shows on the week, and is logged with one tap from Today or from its day in Log, which counts it toward the week. On its day Today leads with a flow to do before it, until the flow is done or the class logged. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: On the welcome, which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip to Set up", then "Skip for now" on "Set up"
Verify that the app opens on the "Today" tab with "Nothing planned"
Tap "Plan your week"
Tap the "+" on today's weekday row in "Routine"
In the "Add to plan" sheet, tap "Sport"
Verify that the sheet lists "BJJ", "Climbing", "Running" and "Something else", with "BJJ" picked
Tap "Add to plan"
Verify that today's row shows a "BJJ class" chip with a pennant beside it
Verify that the "Routine" heading reads "Every week · 1 sport day"
Tap "Back"
Verify that "BJJ" is written under today's dot on the week, which is the plain one of a rest day
Verify that the card under the week reads "Before class" over "Before rolling" and "Mobility · 6 moves · before BJJ · 9:00", with a "Start" button

Verify that a line under the title reads today's weekday and "class day" over "Today is for the mat. Loosen up first.", and that the card's second step is "BJJ class" with "Counts toward your week" and "Log it"
Tap "Log it"
Verify that a notice says "BJJ class logged" with "Undo"

Verify that today's dot on the week is filled and checked, the week card counts "1 workout", the card under it says "Done for today" with "BJJ class" ticked and no "Start" shows, and the card after it says "Nothing more due"
Tap "Undo"
Verify that "Before class" leads again with "BJJ class" and its "Log it" as the step after it, and today's dot is the plain one again
Tap "Start" and verify that the workout shows "Get ready" with "90/90 hip switch" and "Move 1 of 6"
Tap "Skip" until the summary shows "6 moves", then tap "Done"

Verify that Today's card now shows "Before rolling" ticked, then "Up next · Today" with "BJJ class" and "Counts toward your week" over a "Log it" button, with no "Before class", and the week counts "1 workout" and "1 mobility"
Tap the "Log" tab
Tap today's dot on the week
Verify that the day sheet shows "BJJ class" reading "Every" and today's weekday, with "Log it"
Tap "Log it"
Verify that the plan reads "Done" and a "BJJ class" row reading "Logged" has an "×"
Close the sheet
Verify that the log lists "BJJ class" under "Today" and the week's legend has a "Sport" key
Tap the "×" on the "BJJ class" row
Verify that a notice says "Removed BJJ class" with "Undo", and the row is gone
Tap the "Train" tab, then "Programs", and follow "15-minute kettlebell plan"
Tap the "Today" tab
Verify that "Up next · Today" still leads with "BJJ class" and "Log it" (the flow is done for today)
Verify that the step after it is "15-minute kettlebell plan" under "If there is time", with "about 15 min" and "Do it now", and no "Start day 1" shows
Tap "Log it"

Verify that the card now says "Done for today" under a line ending "done" and "That is the day.", and that "15-minute kettlebell plan" waits in the card after it under "If there is time" with "Do it now" and no "Start day 1"
